command:
set -e
printf '%s\n' '--- pwd ---'
pwd
printf '%s\n' '--- /app ---'
ls -la /app 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '--- /data ---'
find /data -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- python ---'
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
print(sys.version)
for m in ['pandas','pyarrow','fastparquet']:
    try:
        mod=__import__(m)
        print(m, getattr(mod,'__version__','available'))
    except Exception as e:
        print(m, 'MISSING', type(e).__name__, e)
PY
